content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Amarillo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or global equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. Critically, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Amarillo's energy, manufacturing, and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, allowing you to master core project management frameworks and terminology while balancing work and personal commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official application to PMI, including proof of education hours and your secondary degree. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Our training team will guide you through the submission process and confirm all documentation is correct before you proceed.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence in the CAPM knowledge domains. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. Most candidates complete the exam within weeks of finishing coursework.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, volunteer work, or other PMI-approved activities. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure continuous credential status and ongoing career advancement in your field.

fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
